page.title: How PrediGol is doing
page.subtitle: What we published and how it went, the days without picks and what is still in evaluation. Always with its sample.
page.preview: Preview: readers do not see this page yet. It is published once you have reviewed it.
page.notAvailable: This page is not published yet.
page.error: We could not load the page.
page.linkHint: What we published, the days without picks and what is in evaluation, with its sample

published.title: Published picks
published.subtitle: Only what we published, counted as in My picks: one unit per pick.
published.none: We have not published any pick yet.
published.small_one: With {count} settled pick we do not show a return yet: the sample is too small to know whether PrediGol wins in the long run.
published.small_other: With {count} settled picks we do not show a return yet: the sample is too small to know whether PrediGol wins in the long run.
published.inconclusive: Below {count} settled picks the sample does not allow a conclusion yet.
published.margin: The margin is one standard error: the real return can be about {points} points above or below.

days.title: Days without picks
days.subtitle: A day without picks is a day when no match met the conditions to publish. We would rather not publish than publish for the sake of it.
days.summary: {without} of {days} days without picks, from {since} to {until}.
days.noneYet: There are no days to count yet.
days.allPicked: There were picks every day, from {since} to {until}.

reasons.no_matches: There were no matches of the competitions we follow
reasons.no_qualified_candidates: No model had beaten the market in its own test yet: there was nothing that could be published
reasons.not_chosen: There were candidates, but none met the rest of the conditions

days.measured_one: On those days PrediGol Intelligence measured {count} selection in evaluation.
days.measured_other: On those days PrediGol Intelligence measured {count} selections in evaluation.
days.reconstructed: Reconstructed from the decisions saved each day.

stops.data: not enough data, or a match not fit to read
stops.calibration: no validated calibration for that market
stops.ev: the odds did not pay enough
stops.correlation: another selection of the same match
stops.final: a market that has not beaten the market yet

markets.title: By kind of bet
markets.subtitle: All time. The kinds with fewer than {count} settled picks go together under «Other».

lineValue.title: Line value
lineValue.definition: It compares the odds we published with the bookmakers' consensus probability without margin, at the last capture before kick-off. Positive: we published above that fair price.
lineValue.none: There are no published picks with their closing reference yet.
lineValue.small_one: {count} pick with its reference: we do not show the mean yet.
lineValue.small_other: {count} picks with their reference: we do not show the mean yet.
lineValue.minutes: The reference was taken, as a median, {minutes} minutes before kick-off.

forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.subtitle: The last probability before kick-off against the result, in the matches finished over the last {days} days.
forecast.uncalibratedNote: We show the model's own number and label it «uncalibrated»: there is no validated calibration yet.
forecast.small: The calibrated sample does not allow showing it yet ({count} matches are needed).
forecast.binLine: When we said between {low} % and {high} %, it happened {observed} % of the time ({count} cases).
forecast.omitted: {count} cases in ranges with fewer than {min} are not shown.

evaluation.title: In evaluation
evaluation.summary: Of {markets} kinds of bet we measure against the market ({pairs} model and market combinations), {passed} have beaten it out of sample.
evaluation.noneYet: No kind of bet has beaten the market in a sustained way yet; that is why we publish little today.
evaluation.qualified: Forecasts of models that beat the market in their own test (the only ones that can be a pick) on those days: {count}.
evaluation.nothing: There are no measurements saved yet.
evaluation.never: We never show selections, odds or results of evaluation: only these counts.

how.title: How a pick is decided
how.intro: All of this must happen for there to be a pick. If nothing meets it, nothing is published that day.

steps.model: A model that has beaten the market in its own test.
steps.value: Odds that pay more than the probability says, with a recent price from several bookmakers.
steps.risk: A bounded risk: no odds too high and no probability too uncertain.
steps.context: The match read by PrediGol Intelligence that same day, with its news.
steps.one: At most one pick per match, and never to fill the day.

definitions.title: Definitions in force
definitions.subtitle: If one changes, we say it here and recompute the history with the new one.
